title: Frog and the stranger.
lines: At the edge of the forest, by the river, lives Frog.
And Hare, who is very clever.
One day Frog sees smoke in the forest.
Someone is sitting by the tent.
The friends have never seen a rat before.
He has never met a rat.
They watch Rat from far away.
Rat is making a bench out of wood.
The next day Frog goes to look.
Rat is sitting by his campfire.
About faraway lands he has been to.
He tells the others about it.
But the others don't want to listen.
A rat is a rat, they say.
One day Piglet falls into the river.
Duck can swim, but Piglet is too heavy.
Then Rat jumps into the water.
He pulls her to the bank.
Rat makes a little fire and gives her a blanket.
Thank you, Rat, says Piglet softly.
I'm sorry for what I said.
A few days later Hare's house has a leak.
Every evening Rat tells a story by the campfire.
But one morning the tent is gone.
The friends are a little sad.
They sit down on the bench that Rat made.
Frog says: He was different from us.
But he was a real friend.
And they look at the road.
Maybe Rat will come back one day.
